name: resume_chain
description: Start psinode on the existing db directory (continue block production). Optionally boot is not run; use boot_chain if the chain is unbooted.

workspace_root.description: psibase repository root (contains db/). Defaults to (in order) explicit value, MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOTS, WORKSPACE_ROOT, CWD.

db_dir.description: Directory psinode uses for chain state. Defaults to <workspace_root>/db. Must match the db_dir used by the prior launch_chain so resume picks up the right chain.

api_url.description: Base URL for readiness checks (GET /native/admin/status). Defaults to http://psibase.localhost:8080/.

errors.description: Another psinode job already holds the lock on db_dir. Use the holder PID/job_id surfaced in the result to investigate, or pass a distinct db_dir.

Pre-flight TCP bind on listen_port failed. Pass a distinct listen_port (and matching api_url / http_host) or stop the process currently holding the port. There is a small race between probe and psinode launch; if another process binds in between, psinode itself will report the same condition.
